incident.exception: unsupported format string passed to NoneType.__format__
incident.cause: The legacy claim-audit formatter assumed checkpoint.config.total_hands was always numeric; the H7 hybrid checkpoint legitimately carries a null value there.
incident.impact: Dashboard/progress reporting became stale. Trainer, endpoint watcher, protocol watcher, treatment launcher, completion watcher, checkpoints, experiment gates and official-hand count were unaffected.

correction.rule: Optional target counts render as unknown; missing or invalid values never crash the reporting-only audit.

preservation_note: The canonical rearm recreated dashboard_watch_rearmed.err.log, leaving a zero-byte current stderr file. The exact traceback was captured before rearm and is reproduced in this immutable correction artifact; no experimental evidence file or trainer artifact was overwritten.
